name: Command Laurels
text: In your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, gain 1 CP. Each Order the bearer issues goes to every friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit on the battlefield at once, with no range or REGIMENT requirement.

effect.name: Command Laurels
effect.text: Gain 1 CP in your Command phase while the bearer lives; the bearer's Orders reach every friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit on the battlefield.

name: Gunnery Officer
text: In your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, gain 1 CP. While a friendly ARTILLERY unit has a model within 6 inches of the bearer's unit, that unit may re-roll the dice that set a weapon's number of attacks, and its models have Lone Operative until they first make an attack.

effect.name: Gunnery Officer
effect.text: Gain 1 CP in your Command phase while the bearer lives; nearby friendly ARTILLERY units re-roll attack-count dice and are Lone Operatives until they attack.
